prompt:
A line-art multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 3 columns and 3 rows of equal 9:16 panels, 9 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a colouring-book drawing: contours only, in one thin uniform black line on white, most of the panel left white. Draw only the people and the few large shapes of the place (walls, doors, windows, a bed, a car). People are simple storyboard figures: hair is one smooth outline of its shape, like a cap, empty inside, with no strands, curls or waves; a face has one short line each for the eyes, brows, nose and mouth, and no stubble, wrinkles or jaw lines; a fence is its posts and top rail, a tree its outline. No texture, mesh, bricks, leaves or fabric folds; no shading, grey or solid black: dark hair, clothes and cars are outlines left white inside. Thin black panel borders, plain white gutters. Location: APARTMENT CORRIDOR, Night, warm interior corridor light.
Image 1: the character sheet of 林青羽 (21), look S2
Image 2: the character sheet of 路少泽 (28), look S1
Image 3: the character sheet of 纪然 (27), look S3
Image 4: the location APARTMENT CORRIDOR, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, with no people
Image 5: the location APARTMENT CORRIDOR, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 6: the location APARTMENT CORRIDOR, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 7: the location APARTMENT CORRIDOR, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, with no people
Image 8: the location APARTMENT CORRIDOR, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, with no people
Image 9: the blocking reference of this segment, the same place with its people in their places at the start; use it only for where each person is and which way they face, and keep each person on that seat or spot, on the same side of the room, in every panel until a shot moves them; do not copy its colours or light
Image 10: the prop grocery bag full of greens; use only structure, material, and color
Image 11: the prop black handbag; use only structure, material, and color
Draw each character so they can be told apart as in their reference image, by the shape of the hairstyle, the build and the outfit in outline only; never copy the photograph's detail. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location images only for the layout of the space and the place of its furniture and props, drawn in outline. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location images, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: Ji Ran and Lin Qingyu stand side by side on the runner rug with their backs to Ji Ran's apartment door, his right arm around her waist and the grocery bag full of greens in his left hand; Ji Ran has the black handbag on her shoulder and her arms folded. Lu Shaoze stands on the runner rug one step in front of them, facing Ji Ran's apartment door, gaping. The camera stays on the side of the cream wall opposite Ji Ran's apartment door.
Panel 1: Medium shot, slow push in on Lin Qingyu, eye-level. Lin Qingyu lets go of Ji Ran and leans toward Lu Shaoze with an exaggerated, concerned frown.
Panel 2: Close-up, locked-off camera, eye-level, on Lu Shaoze. Lu Shaoze's face reddens, and a vein tightens at his temple.
Panel 3: Medium close-up, slight low angle, handheld, on Lin Qingyu. Lin Qingyu gives Lu Shaoze an innocent, wide-eyed smile.
Panel 4: Close-up insert, locked-off camera, eye-level, on Lu Shaoze's shoulder. Lin Qingyu's hand pats Lu Shaoze's navy suit shoulder twice.
Panel 5: Medium shot, handheld whip, eye-level, two-shot of Lu Shaoze and Lin Qingyu. Lu Shaoze slaps Lin Qingyu's hand off his shoulder.
Panel 6: Medium close-up, low angle, handheld, on Lu Shaoze. Lu Shaoze jabs his finger back and forth between Ji Ran and Lin Qingyu, his mouth opening and closing without a word, shaking with fury.
Panel 7: Wide shot, locked-off camera, eye-level, down the corridor. Lu Shaoze spins round and storms off along the runner rug, away from Ji Ran's apartment door.
Panel 8: Medium shot, slow push in, eye-level, two-shot of Ji Ran and Lin Qingyu in front of her door. Ji Ran and Lin Qingyu turn their heads and exchange a look.
Panel 9: Close-up, locked-off camera, eye-level, on Lin Qingyu. Lin Qingyu breaks into a wide, mischievous grin and lifts the grocery bag full of greens.
Revision notes: In panels 1, 3, 4, 5, 8 and 9 the young man Lin Qingyu (Image 1: short tousled hair, white pullover hoodie, black joggers, white sneakers) is the one who acts: in panel 1 he leans toward Lu Shaoze with a concerned frown, in panel 3 he smiles innocently, in panel 4 his hoodie-sleeved hand pats Lu Shaoze's shoulder, in panel 5 Lu Shaoze slaps Lin Qingyu's hand away, and in panel 9 Lin Qingyu grins and lifts the grocery bag. Ji Ran (Image 3) does none of these actions and never holds the grocery bag; she appears only in panels 6 and 8.
Keep the characters, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no photographic rendering.
